lean.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (η : ℝ), 0 < η → MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1, p.1 + Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E)) = (μ.prod (volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E)).withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * η))⁻¹) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E * Real.exp (-‖p.2 - p.1‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η))))
approved_definition_context: stdGaussian E is the centered standard Gaussian probability law with identity covariance. IsProbabilityMeasure μ means total mass one. μ.prod ν is the product measure; for probability measures it represents independent coordinates. Measure.map is pushforward along the displayed map. All displayed maps are continuous and hence Borel measurable.

volume is canonical Lebesgue/Haar measure provided by the finite-dimensional real inner-product-space instance, normalized by orthonormal coordinates; no arbitrary MeasureSpace E is assumed. BorelSpace identifies measurable sets with the topology's Borel sigma algebra. In dimension zero canonical volume is unit mass at the only point.

m.withDensity q weights the reference measure m by the extended nonnegative density q. For measurable A it is the nonnegative integral of q over A. ENNReal.ofReal maps nonnegative real numbers into extended nonnegative reals and sends negatives to zero. Module.finrank ℝ E is the natural-number dimension; powers are natural-number powers.

Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root, Real.pi is the circle constant, • is real scalar multiplication and the norm comes from the inner product. Division and reciprocals are totalized at zero; the displayed positive scale makes their denominators nonzero.
